title: Luna and the Lost-and-Found Train
description: Luna and Teo find a forgotten bag on the train and discover the car where nothing is ever fully lost.

cover.alt: Luna walks toward the station with her basket, at sunset, with the train waiting

illustration.alt: Luna walks toward the station with a basket, at sunset, with the train waiting

blocks.title: Off to the station
lines: At sunset, Luna leaves home with her basket and walks toward the station.
The sky turns orange, and the train is already puffing a little steam, ready for the trip.
Today she's headed to grandma's house, and for the first time her friend Teo will meet her there.

illustration.alt: Teo, in the garden, shows a mended mitten, a paper boat, and an orange scarf with a moon stitched on it

blocks.title: The mended mitten
lines: Before leaving, Teo checks his bag: a mitten his grandma mended for him last winter.

blocks.title: The paper boat
lines: He also packs a paper boat he folded himself, his favorite toy for the trip.

blocks.title: The scarf
lines: And he puts on an orange scarf with a moon stitched on it, a gift he wears whenever he travels.

illustration.alt: Teo walks to the station: steps on a loose board, splashes a puddle, sees the train puff steam, gets nervous, Dora whistles, and a freight car full of boxes

blocks.title: Crack!
lines: Crack! A loose board on the platform creaks under Teo's foot.

blocks.title: Splash!
lines: Splash! A puddle sprays him and soaks his green sneaker.

blocks.title: The train puffs
lines: Far off, the engine lets out a cloud of white steam.

blocks.title: Teo gets nervous
lines: —It's my first trip here all by myself —Teo thinks, a bit nervous.

blocks.title: Dora whistles
lines: Dora, the conductor, whistles from the platform: it's almost time.

blocks.title: The freight car
lines: Behind, an open car holds boxes and suitcases from other trips.

variants.prompt: What did Teo step on along the way?
variants.correctFeedback: Yes! A loose board creaked under his foot.
variants.retryFeedback: Look at the first panel of this page again.

variants.prompt: Why do you think Teo felt nervous on the way?

options.text: It was his first trip to the station alone

variants.correctFeedback: Right: it was his first time getting there alone.
variants.retryFeedback: Reread what Teo thinks in panel four.

illustration.alt: An empty bench by the train with a clock; Luna arrives worried with her basket; Teo cries on the platform; Dora comes over to help

blocks.title: The empty platform
lines: Teo waits alone by a bench, watching the station clock tick slower than he'd like.

blocks.title: Luna arrives
lines: When Luna finally arrives with her basket, she notices something's wrong right away.

blocks.title: Teo cries
lines: —I thought you weren't coming, and I didn't know what to do —Teo says, eyes full of tears.

blocks.title: Dora helps
lines: —I'm here, and so is Dora —Luna smiles, as the conductor walks over calmly.

illustration.alt: Teo waits a bit calmer on the platform; Luna points at the train with a smile, next to Dora

blocks.title: Teo calms down
lines: Teo wipes his tears and takes a deep breath, already feeling much calmer.

blocks.title: Luna points at the train
lines: —Look, it's almost leaving! —says Luna, pointing at the train with a huge smile.

illustration.alt: Luna and Teo crouch to look at the train's wheels; then they climb the first steps while Dora watches

blocks.title: The train wheels
lines: They walk up to the train and crouch down to look at its huge metal wheels.

blocks.title: First steps
lines: Then they climb the first steps, while Dora watches patiently from the door.

illustration.alt: The train waits with its door open; Luna climbs the steps; Teo talks with Dora on the platform

blocks.title: The train waits
lines: The train waits with its door wide open, ready for every passenger to climb aboard.

blocks.title: Luna climbs first
lines: Luna climbs the steps carefully, holding her basket steady with both hands.

blocks.title: Teo and Dora talk
lines: —Can I show you my ticket? —Teo asks, pulling it out of his pocket proudly.

illustration.alt: Teo and Luna board the train: they show a ticket, point, Dora waves a wing, the door handle, Dora opens the door and both step in

blocks.title: The ticket
lines: —Here's my ticket —Teo says, showing it off proudly.

blocks.title: Luna points
lines: Luna points to the right car, the third one from the engine.

blocks.title: Dora waves
lines: Dora waves a wing from the door, welcoming them aboard.

blocks.title: The handle
lines: The door handle shines under the afternoon sun.

blocks.title: Dora opens the door
lines: Dora pushes the door open carefully and lets them go first.

blocks.title: They board
lines: Luna and Teo climb the steps and step into the car, happy.

variants.prompt: What did Teo show Dora before boarding?
variants.correctFeedback: Correct! He showed her his ticket.
variants.retryFeedback: Look at the first panel of this page again.

variants.prompt: How do we know Dora welcomes them warmly?

options.text: She waves and lets them go first
She checks the ticket without a word

variants.correctFeedback: Right: she greets them and steps aside.
variants.retryFeedback: Notice what Dora does in panels three and five.

illustration.alt: The train doors slam shut with a huge burst of sound as the train starts moving; below, Luna and Teo are startled

blocks.title: Choo!
lines: Choo, choo!

blocks.title: The train starts
lines: The doors slam shut and the train starts moving slowly, leaving the station behind.

illustration.alt: They sit down and Dora peeks in to say hello; they notice a bag under the seat; they crouch to look; they open it together

blocks.title: They sit down
lines: They sit on a purple bench, and Dora peeks in for a moment to see how they're doing.

blocks.title: Something under the seat
lines: Suddenly, Luna spots a yellow bag hidden under the seat across from them.

blocks.title: They crouch down
lines: —Whose could it be? —Teo asks, crouching down for a closer look.

blocks.title: They open it
lines: Carefully, they unzip it to see what's inside.

illustration.alt: The bag shakes; they tell Dora; they walk toward her; they show her the bag

blocks.title: The bag shakes
lines: The bag shakes on its own, as if something inside were moving.

blocks.title: It's not theirs
lines: —This isn't ours —says Luna—. We should tell Dora.

blocks.title: They find her
lines: They walk down the aisle of the car until they find her.

blocks.title: They show her
lines: —Dora, we found this! —they say together, pointing at the yellow bag.

variants.prompt: Why do Luna and Teo tell Dora?

options.text: Because they want to get off

variants.correctFeedback: That's it! The bag wasn't theirs.
variants.retryFeedback: Reread what Luna says in panel two.

variants.prompt: What does telling Dora say about Luna and Teo?

options.text: That they are honest and care about others' things
That they are scared of the bag
That they want to keep the bag

variants.correctFeedback: Exactly: instead of keeping it, they speak up right away.
variants.retryFeedback: Think about why they tell Dora instead of keeping the bag.

illustration.alt: Luna sitting, thoughtful, next to an orange scarf with a moon stitched on it

blocks.title: Luna thinks
lines: While Dora checks the bag, Luna sits thinking about who could have forgotten it.
Inside are a mended mitten and an orange scarf with a moon stitched on it, just like her own name.
—How curious —Luna thinks—, someone else loves moons just as much as I do.

illustration.alt: Dora opens a chest with more kept objects; they talk; Luna points, excited; they celebrate; they find another similar scarf

blocks.title: A full chest
lines: Dora opens a wooden chest with a ball, a purple cloth, and an old letter.

blocks.title: Many stories
lines: —Every single thing here has its own story —Dora tells them, smiling.

blocks.title: Luna points
lines: Luna points at something with one finger, growing more and more excited.

blocks.title: She found something!
lines: —Look at this! —she says, pulling out another scarf with a moon stitched on it.

blocks.title: They celebrate
lines: Teo and Luna celebrate together, happy about the small discovery.

blocks.title: Not the only one
lines: Luna smiles: she isn't the only one who loves moons so much.

illustration.alt: Luna and Teo look at a shelf with a hat, a box, and an umbrella; Dora places the bag in the lost-and-found chest

blocks.title: The shelf
lines: Dora leads them to a small car with a shelf: a green hat, a box, and a purple umbrella.
—This is the lost-and-found car —she explains—.
Everything waits here until its owner comes back to look for it.

blocks.title: The chest
lines: Dora opens the wooden chest and tucks the yellow bag in with care, next to a ball and a blue suitcase.
—On this train —Dora says, smiling—, nothing is ever fully lost.

variants.prompt: What does Dora keep in the lost-and-found car?

options.text: Things people forget on the train

variants.retryFeedback: Reread what Dora explains in the first panel.

variants.prompt: What does Dora mean by «nothing is ever fully lost»?

options.text: Lost things wait for someone to look for them
The train never loses its way

variants.correctFeedback: Exactly: there's always a place to find them again.
variants.retryFeedback: Think about what the lost-and-found car is for.

illustration.alt: Back at their seat, they find the forgotten paper boat; they grab it; they walk toward the train door

blocks.title: Back at their seat
lines: Back at their seat, Teo spots something forgotten on the bench.

blocks.title: Almost forgot it!
lines: —I almost left my own boat! —Teo laughs, grabbing it just in time.

blocks.title: Walking together
lines: Luna and Teo walk toward the door, ready to get off at their station.

blocks.title: They thank Dora
lines: —Thank you for everything, Dora! —they both say, smiling.

illustration.alt: Luna and Teo step off the train and wave goodbye to Dora on the platform

blocks.title: Goodbye
lines: They step off the train hand in hand, paper boat safe and huge smiles on their faces.
Dora waves from the door: «See you next trip!»
And Luna thinks that, thanks to a lost bag, she made a new friend who shares her name.

variants.prompt: What did Luna and Teo do when they found the bag?

options.text: Gave it to Dora to keep safe

variants.correctFeedback: Yes! They gave it to Dora.
variants.retryFeedback: Think about what they did when they found the bag.

variants.prompt: What is the message of this story?

options.text: Taking care of others' things is a way of taking care of each other
You should keep everything you find
Trains are the best place to lose things

variants.correctFeedback: Right: caring for others' things is a way of caring for one another.
variants.retryFeedback: Think about what Luna and Teo learned on the trip.

station.definition: The place where the train stops for people to get on and off.

conductor.definition: The person who takes care of the train and checks tickets.

forgotten.definition: Something someone left behind by accident.

platform.definition: The part of the station where you wait for the train.

engine.definition: The part of the train that has the motor and pulls the cars.

mended.definition: Fixed with careful stitching after a small tear.

stitched.definition: Sewn with thread and a needle to make a pattern.

chest.definition: A wooden box with a lid, used for keeping things.

proud.definition: Feeling very happy about something you did well.

curious.definition: Wanting to know more about something.
